mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidney does more than simply remove waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the bladder was straightforward progress, but less interesting than following what happens to the filtered fluid.

surprise.text: I was surprised that useful glucose and water pass through the filter along with wastes and then need to be recovered.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the routes, although the final connection was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would continue: following the filter and recovery route made me curious about how other body systems work together.
